record.original_question: A central point of [LiangSag2024, Th. 3.1] is that for any partitionλ= (λ 1, λ2, . . . λℓ(λ)) withλ 1 ≥λ 2 ≥ · · · ≥ λℓ(λ) >0, if we defineλ+i= (λ 1 +i, λ 2 +i, . . . , λℓ(λ) +i), then the set of partitions (λ+i) i≥0 has the property that for every n, the set of intervals in the partition lattice{[λ+n, λ+ (n+k)]|k≥0}are all isomorphic. This series of elements allows their Order Ideal Lemma (Lem. 1.1) to be applied. Similar series of elements can be found in other distributive Fomin lattices, the lattice of strict partitions, the lattice ofk-row partitions, and the cylindric partitions. This is surprising since this property does not seem to be forced by the hypotheses of distributive Fomin lattices. Can this observation be extended to the Young–Fibonacci lattices? That is, are there sequences of elements in YF_r, (p i)i≥0 for which for every n, the set of intervals{[p n, pn+k]|k≥0}are all isomorphic? If there are, can they be used to prove an analog of their Th. 3.1? If so, does this provide a clue to a “semi-distributive” property ofYF_r?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Background. For a partition $\lambda = (\lambda_1 \ge \lambda_2 \ge \cdots \ge \lambda_{\ell(\lambda)} > 0)$ and an integer $i \ge 0$, write $\lambda + i := (\lambda_1+i, \lambda_2+i, \ldots, \lambda_{\ell(\lambda)}+i)$. In Young's lattice (the distributive lattice of partitions ordered by inclusion of Young diagrams), the family $(\lambda+i)_{i\ge 0}$ has the property that for every $n \ge 0$ the intervals $\{[\lambda+n,\, \lambda+(n+k)] : k \ge 0\}$ are pairwise order-isomorphic (as $n$ varies, with $k$ fixed). Analogous sequences are known in several other distributive Fomin (differential-poset) lattices, including the lattice of strict partitions, the lattice of $k$-row partitions, and lattices of cylindric partitions.

Setup. Fix an integer $r \ge 1$ and let $\mathrm{YF}_r$ denote the rank-$r$ Young–Fibonacci lattice (the $r$-fold version of the Young–Fibonacci differential poset, which is non-distributive but $r$-differential). Order on $\mathrm{YF}_r$ is the usual Young–Fibonacci covering order extended transitively.

Problem. Determine whether there exists an infinite sequence $(p_i)_{i\ge 0}$ of elements of $\mathrm{YF}_r$ such that, for every $n \ge 0$, all intervals in the family
$$\{[p_n,\, p_{n+k}] : k \ge 0\}$$
are mutually order-isomorphic; equivalently, for each fixed $k \ge 0$, the interval $[p_n, p_{n+k}]$ is independent (up to isomorphism) of $n$.

If such sequences exist, decide whether they can be used to establish an analog, in $\mathrm{YF}_r$, of the order-ideal/interval-stability theorem available in distributive Fomin lattices, and whether their existence reflects a "semi-distributive"-type structural property of $\mathrm{YF}_r$.
